profile.headline: Engineer
profile.summary: I have developed talent in the engineering field and believe I can help improve the quality of lives of others, one step at a time.

positions.title: Systems Engineer
positions.description:
●	Lead the design of electrical powertrains for 4 new Electric Vehicle (EV) and ICE-conversion projects
●	Collaborate with global suppliers, frequently communicating in Mandarin Chinese
●	Developed and currently overseeing a patent-pending advanced battery design for EVs
●	Manage project timelines and budgets, ensuring successful project completion

positions.title: Researcher
positions.description:
●	Developed mathematical models for radiative behavior in Origami-inspired solar panel and radiator designs
●	Enhanced efficiency of existing ray tracing practices through in-house ray tracing algorithms
●	Led a team in validating experiments by providing simulated heat transfer results
●	Presented research findings at international academic conferences

positions.title: Manufacturing Processing & Industrial Engineering
positions.description:
●	Proactively addressed manufacturing defects for over 2000 products
●	Analyzed manufacturing data to optimize factory performance
●	Conducted lead time predictions to support contract bidding
●	Automated engineering workflows using Excel and @Risk, improving efficiency

volunteerExperiences.companyName: The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints
volunteerExperiences.description:
•	12+ months experience in overseeing groups of  6-24 team members and presenting training
•	Worked 70+ hours each week
•	Experienced in goal setting, training, and following up on goals

company.name: The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints
